sections.heading: Product Description
sections.text: Product Description Introducing the ultimate savior for the bed of the clumsy! Say goodbye to soggy sheets and hello to a dry and cozy night's sleep with our waterproof mattress protector. With a luxurious bamboo feel, you'll feel like you're sleeping on a cloud while also reaping the benefits of our mattress protector's natural moisture-wicking properties. But that's not all! Our mattress protector also features elasticised corners, ensuring a snug fit around your mattress, no matter how much you toss and turn in your sleep. It's the perfect solution for those of you who value comfort and convenience. So go ahead, spill that glass of water or accidentally knock over your morning coffee. With our waterproof mattress protector, you can rest easy knowing that your mattress is protected from any mishaps. It is made from quality fabric that’s hypoallergenic and provides a healthier sleep environment by blocking fluids, moisture, dust mites, bed bugs, and stains from penetrating your mattress. It also helps circulate the air and transport moisture, directly impacting your comfort and sleep. It’s built to last and the moisture-wicking properties will keep it from overheating. The soft, breathable and sweat-absorbent mattress protector with no crinkly noise ensures comfort and reduces irritation to leave you feeling refreshed every morning. The mattress protector is machine washable. It is recommended to wash on a gentle machine cycle and tumble dry on low heat with linens and towels, or you can air-dry. TPU film with terry fabric allows air to pass through but blocks any fluids or liquids from seeping through to the mattress. The moisture-wicking properties of the fabric add to the micro-vented breathable mattress protector. The material is anti-allergenic, so it does not irritate the skin, and it’s durable. sections.heading: Breathe easy, and sleep comfortably
sections.text: Breathe easy, and sleep comfortably Your mattress's new best friend. Crafted with a combination of natural bamboo and waterproof materials, this protector is designed to shield your investment from life's little accidents. Say goodbye to worries about spills, stains, and other unsavory substances that can accumulate over time. The breathable bamboo fabric ensures a comfortable sleep environment while protecting against dust mites and allergens. Its waterproof layer acts as a barrier against liquid mishaps, preserving the integrity of your mattress. With the Sleepyhead Mattress Protector, you can rest easy knowing that your mattress is safeguarded against the not-so-pleasant realities of daily life. Keep your mattress fresh, clean, and protected for years to come with this essential bedroom accessory. Healthy and hygienic It is made from quality bamboo terry material that’s hypoallergenic and provides a healthier sleep environment by blocking fluids, moisture, dust mites, bed bugs, and stains from penetrating your mattress. It also helps circulate the air and transport moisture, directly impacting your comfort and sleep. The moisture-wicking properties will keep it from overheating. The soft, breathable and sweat-absorbent mattress protector with no crinkly noise ensures comfort and reduces irritation to leave you feeling refreshed every morning. The bamboo mattress protector is machine washable. It is recommended to wash on a gentle machine cycle and tumble dry on low heat with linens, or you can air-dry. Laminated TPU film with Terry Bamboo fabric TPU film with terry bamboo fabric allows air to pass through but blocks any fluids or liquids from seeping through to the mattress. The moisture-wicking properties of the bamboo fibre add to the micro-vented breathable mattress protector. The material is anti-allergenic, so it does not irritate the skin, and it’s durable. Sleepyhead's mattress protector is certified and awarded to meet the strict guidelines by OEKO-TEX®. With the OEKO-TEX Certification seal, you can rest assured knowing that you have a mattress protector that is free from any harmful chemicals. It is the highest global standard to bring you a safe sleep surface.
